subject.title: Interactive parity with the Codex runtime: ask-user-question · plan mode · goal mode

question: Should this broad interactive-parity branch land as one core PR with default-on `update_plan` and new public question/SDK surfaces, or be split and narrowed before merge?
rationale: The PR changes core interaction policy, public SDK shape, protocol/events, channel delivery, UI, and unattended goal continuation, so automation can identify blockers but cannot choose the permanent product/API rollout.

options.title: Fix and split before merge
options.body: Require the approval/SDK fixes first, then split or stage the question, plan, and goal surfaces so each API/default decision is reviewed independently.

options.title: Land as one feature after fixes
options.body: Keep the one-branch shape but require explicit maintainer approval for default-on tools, SDK exports, protocol/channel behavior, and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Defer core rollout
options.body: Pause or close the PR if maintainers want this capability to remain a plugin/roadmap experiment until the core API direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Fix and split before merge
recommendation.body: Require the approval/SDK fixes first, then split or stage the question, plan, and goal surfaces so each API/default decision is reviewed independently.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main history points to vincentkoc as the recent contributor on the central UI and plugin SDK files touched by the unresolved decisions.
